newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Financial service stocks started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Financial service stocks started.

text.p: -- Smith Barney analyst Dean Eberling said he reinitated a group of financial service and brokerage stocks.

-- reinitiated the following as buy: Dean Witter Discover & Co, Alliance Capital Management LP, A.G. Edwards Inc, Franklin Resources Inc, PIMCO Advisors LP, Oppenheimer Capital LP, United Asset Management Corp and Legg Mason Inc.
-- restarted Lehman Brothers Holdings Inc as outperform.
-- reinitiated the following as neutral: Merrill Lynch and Co Inc, Bear Stearns Cos Inc, PaineWebber Group Inc, Hambrecht & Quist Inc, Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette and Salomon Inc.
-- also reinitiated as neutral: T. Rowe Price Associates Inc, Charles Schwab Corp, Pioneer Group Inc and John Nuveen Co.
